name: pre-push
html:
#!/usr/bin/env zsh
# luiskr.com pre-push gate — scoped by module, split across two contexts:
#
#   • inside a module (submodule) — runs THAT module's full gate set
#     (scoped tsc, eslint, stylelint, jest + governance) via the
#     superproject's shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs, then stamps
#     reports/gate-result.json so the parent never re-runs it.
#   • superproject root — diffs the push range; bare gitlink bumps
#     (link:<path>) validate the module's stored gate result instead of
#     re-running, and fall back to the real gates when the stamp is
#     missing or points at another commit.
#
# CMS never runs a11y/Lighthouse; experiments never watch Lighthouse
# performance — the contract lives in shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs.
#
# Installed by shared/scripts/install-hooks.mjs → <repo>/.git/hooks/pre-push
# (and into every submodule's hooks dir).

set -euo pipefail

SUPER="$(git rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree 2>/dev/null || true)"

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# ── Module context ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if [[ -n "$SUPER" ]]; then
  SG="$SUPER/shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs"
  REL="${PWD#$SUPER/}"
  SCOPE="$(node "$SG" scope "$REL")"

  echo "── pre-push: module gates for ${SCOPE:-$REL} ──"
  if [[ -n "$SCOPE" ]]; then
    # 'self' skips when HEAD already carries a passing stamp — a re-push
    # of gated commits never re-runs the suite.
    node "$SG" self "$SCOPE"
  else
    # Module outside the gate registry (e.g. star-field before mapping):
    # still run its own suite so pushes never ship unverified code.
    if [[ -f jest.config.mjs ]]; then
      node --experimental-vm-modules --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning \
        "$SUPER/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js" --config jest.config.mjs
    fi
  fi

  command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && git lfs pre-push "$@"
  exit 0
fi

# ── Superproject context ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Resolve the push range: prefer upstream tracking ref, then origin/main,
# then a single-parent diff, then the full workspace.
RANGE=""
if git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RANGE="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream})...HEAD"
elif git rev-parse --verify origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RANGE="origin/main...HEAD"
elif git rev-parse --verify HEAD~1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RANGE="HEAD~1..HEAD"
fi

if [[ -n "$RANGE" ]]; then
  SCOPES="$(node shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs areas "$RANGE")"
else
  SCOPES=""
fi

# Empty diff (push of an unchanged tree) → nothing to gate.
if [[ -z "$SCOPES" && -n "$RANGE" ]]; then
  echo "── pre-push: no changed module files — nothing to gate ──"
  exit 0
fi

echo "── pre-push: scoped gates for ${SCOPES:-all modules} ──"
# ${(s: :)...} word-splits — plain ${SCOPES} would pass the whole list as
# one argv element and scope-gates would match zero scopes silently.
if [[ -n "$SCOPES" ]]; then
  node shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs run ${(s: :)SCOPES}
else
  node shared/scripts/verify/scope-gates.mjs run --all
fi

command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 && git lfs pre-push "$@"
